messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.46-2
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.46-2) has been released at its website (http://rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN in the next day or two.

There is a small bug fix related to parallel MQM permutations, plus a change related to an upcoming change in R 4.0 (to be released in April), in which the default for stringsAsFactors will be changed from TRUE to FALSE.

For a list of the changes, see https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
